question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"raise."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Raise" **means to lift or elevate something to a higher position or level. (कुछ) ऊपर उठाना) • **Example**: *The government plan to **raise__** taxes.* • The word fits in the blank as it suggests an increase or improvement in the subject. • Grammatically, it is a verb in its infinitive form. • The correct answer is option 3. • Correct passage: If you __surround__ yourself with the good and righteous, they can only __**raise**__ you up. If you ______ (3) ______ yourself with the others, they will ______ (4) ______ you down into the doldrums of mediocrity, and they will keep you there, but only as long as you ______ (5) ______ it. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Replace"** means to substitute or exchange something with another. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु का स्‍थान लेना; किसी व्यक्ति या वस्‍तु के स्‍थान पर दूसरे को ले आना) • **"Tarnish"** means to damage the reputation or image of something or someone. ((धातु आदि की) चमक घट जाना या घटा देना) • **"Vanish"** means to disappear or go missing without a trace. (एकाएक ग़ायब हो जाना (ऐसे कि पता न चले), ओझल हो जाना) 3f:Tf46, The correct answer is **"encircle."**
